# DailyDrop app content API v1 (static JSON, generated by site/build.js on every site deploy)

Base: https://dailydropnewspaper.com/app/v1/   (also written to the build output dir as app/v1/…)
All files UTF-8 JSON, `Cache-Control` follows the site default. Only editions that are already public at build time (publish_at <= DD_NOW) are written — scheduled editions appear in the deploy that reveals them (same as the web).

## index.json
{ "v":1, "generated":"ISO", "regions":[ { "code":"KR", "name":{"ko":"대한민국","en":"South Korea",…}, "prefix":"", "langs":["ko","en","ja"], "tz":"Asia/Seoul",
    "latest":{"date":"2026-10-10","no":6}, "editions":[{"date":"2026-10-10","no":6,"langs":["ko","en","ja"]}, …newest first] } … ] }

## {REGION}/{date}.{lang}.json  (one per edition × available language)
{ "v":1, "region":"KR", "lang":"ko", "date":"2026-10-10", "no":6, "publishAt":"ISO", "url":"https://dailydropnewspaper.com/2026-10-10/",
  "mast": { "label":"제6호", "dateline":"대한민국, 2026년 10월 10일 토요일", "time":"06:00 KST", "house":"…", "ears":["…","…"] },
  "stories":[ { "id":"nobel", "rank":0, "kick":"…", "hl":"…", "dek":"…", "body":["para", …],
                "popup":{ "kick","title","what","why","me","a","b","say","src" } } … in page order ],
  "blocks":[ { "type":"nums|next|strip|rumor|one|fill|glos|colophon|other", "title":"…", "html":"sanitized inner HTML (only b,i,em,strong,a,br,p,ul,ol,li,span,small,table,tr,td,th)" } … ],
  "glossary":{ "term":{"f":"field","d":"definition","w":"why today"} },
  "influencers":[ {"who","where","date","u","t":"text in this lang (fallback en)"} ],
  "sources":[…extras src list if present…],
  "breaking":"/api/breaking.json?region=KR&lang=ko"   // live endpoint, same as web
}
Strings are plain text except `blocks[].html`. `body` paragraphs are plain text; glossary terms are matched client-side (same rule as web linkTerms: longest key first, first occurrence per story).

## glossary/{lang}.json
Aggregate of every public edition's glossary in that language: { "terms":[{"term","f","d","w","region","date"}…] } newest first, de-duplicated by term (keep newest).
